capabilities: Hide bold, italic, and highlighted text in notes
Reveal hidden text by clicking the filled area
Configure per-note masking via frontmatter properties
Show blur or peek hints before full reveal
Convert masked areas into cloze blanks when exporting to PDF
disambiguation: Not a flashcard app; it masks text in place for memorization rather than generating review cards.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Japanese). PDF cloze export requires the desktop app and plugin version 1.1.0 or later.
motivation: To aid memorization, hide text in bold, italics, and highlighted text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mask formatted text for self-testing and memorization while reading notes.
summary: Memorization aid that hides bold, italic, and highlighted text in the editor until clicked, with hint modes and PDF cloze export.
